Subject: Renewal + expansion pricing discussion / next steps

Hi Sarah —

Great to speak today. Quick recap from our call and the asks I promised to follow up on:

- Current state: Acme Health is on Redwood hosted with chat-prod and embeddings-v1 routes. Current monthly tokens (avg): ~45M tokens (chat heavy).
- Renewal/expansion ask: Expecting growth to ~200M tokens/month within 12 months post-renewal; embeddings will increase as search/product features expand.
- Procurement timeline: Targeting a renewal decision in early April so we can lock rates for the FY.

Pricing qualification / asks for you: can you confirm the budget range you have in mind for this renewal (monthly or annual), and whether you have a target $/1M tokens we should aim for when we put together a blended proposal? Also confirm which additional routes/models you want included in the renewal (e.g., embeddings-v2, chat-prod-high-cap).

What I’ll put together:
- A renewal proposal with volume step-up tiers and a blended-rate example for your projected 200M tokens/month mix.
- Options: 12-month committed vs. 24-month committed pricing (with deeper step-ups for longer commits).
- Line items for adding new routes/models and any dedicated capacity needs.

Attached is the Q1 usage export I referenced (usage_breakdown_q1.csv) for your review.

Suggested next step: if you can send your budget range and confirmation of which routes to include by EOD Wed, I’ll have a preliminary blended pricing and tiered proposal ready for review by Fri.

Thanks —
Marissa

Hi Marissa —

Thanks for the summary — super helpful. Confirming the high-level numbers from our side:

- Current avg: ~45M tokens / month (primarily chat-prod).
- Near-term (3–6 months): expect to hit ~80–100M as we roll out two new features.
- 12-month target: ~180–220M/month (mix: ~70% chat, ~30% embeddings).

Budget / target: we don’t have a hard $/1M target yet. At the org level we’re budgeting roughly $15k–$30k/month for LLM spend today, but that won’t scale with growth. For renewal we’d ideally see something that scales to ~200M tokens/month within a $60k–$100k/month budget window (we can be flexible depending on commitment/term).

We definitely want a blended proposal that accounts for chat-prod and embeddings-v2 (higher embedding volume). Also include a line for the new high-capacity route (chat-prod-high-cap) for a small portion of calls (10–15%).

Procurement: CFO wants simple T&Cs and a single committed contract if we can get predictable unit economics.

Happy to review the proposal on Fri — but yes, will confirm budget range with finance tomorrow and get back to you.

Best,
Sarah

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>

Date: Wed, 11 Mar 2026 11:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal + expansion pricing discussion / next steps

Hi Sarah —

Thanks — that helps a lot. Based on your projected mix (70% chat, 30% embeddings) and the 180–220M target, here are two high-level pricing approaches I’ll model into the formal proposal:

1) Blended-tier example (12-month commit, step-up volumes) — illustrative: 
   - 0–50M: $120 / 1M tokens
   - 50–200M: $90 / 1M tokens
   - 200M+: $60 / 1M tokens
   => Weighted blended for 200M monthly (70/30 split) lands around ~$75 / 1M tokens.

2) Premium model mix (if you need chat-prod-high-cap for latency-sensitive routes): add a +40–80% uplift for high-capacity model usage (example: $126–$162 / 1M tokens for that portion).

Notes: committed reserved capacity (Dedicated) or a longer term (24-month) can push the blended $/1M meaningfully lower — I’ll show a 10–20% delta for longer/committed terms. Also we can cap increases on model additions and provide a predictable blended rate that includes up to X% of traffic on new routes; anything beyond that is pass-through at published rates (we’ll make those thresholds explicit).

Next for Friday: I’ll send a formal PDF proposal with the two options (12mo vs 24mo), explicit step-up tiers, and per-route addenda for chat-prod-high-cap and embeddings-v2. Would you like the proposal to show monthly invoice amounts (based on your 200M example) or only the per-1M pricing tiers and blended totals?

Marissa
